integrity: The universal inequalities and zero-rate criterion are derived in RESULT.md. The finite verifier is confirmatory, not a proof of infinite limits. Prior general results with alphabet size at least three and periodic scheduling are acknowledged. Independent review is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only doubling modulo one with the two fixed quarter-cylinders 00 and 11 and prescribed deterministic hole choices.
For arbitrary nonperiodic schedules the entropy rate need not converge; liminf/limsup prefix rates are the quantities proved.
The periodic alternating case can already be computed by the published periodic-finite-type formalism; the new conclusion is the full arbitrary-schedule defect-density equivalence.
No assertion of an independent priority search or audit.
title: Sparse repetition is the exact zero-growth boundary for two moving dyadic holes
